name: Gates Motel
source:
The protagonist is an 18 years old guy who grew up in a family of five. His parents were Norma and Frank Gates, until he lost his father in a freak accident.

Before his death, Frank had started to drink, and transformed into a complete jerk, not paying attention to anyone, so Norma was the only parent for all of you. Recently you discovered, that Norma had suffered from Frank's abuse, but didn't tell anyone about her problems, and just lived with it - till Frank's accident. He has died from falling down the stairs while being completely drunk, and finished his miserable life quickly and painlessly. Nevertheless, the pension you received - due to loss of the breadwinner - gave you the chance to start some  business.

Norma decided to sell the house and invest almost all the money to buy some motel on the other end of the world. And that's where you're heading now...

The manor (or 'Psycho house') will keep your kinky secrets under cover.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/P_S_Y_C_H_O]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名18岁的青年，在一个五口之家长大。他的父母是诺尔玛与弗兰克·盖茨，然而，一场离奇的意外夺走了父亲的生命。

去世前，弗兰克开始酗酒，变成了一个彻头彻尾的混蛋，对谁都漠不关心。对你们来说，诺尔玛成了唯一尽到责任的家长。最近你才得知，诺尔玛一直遭受弗兰克的虐待，却从未向任何人倾诉，只是默默忍受，直到弗兰克出事。他在烂醉如泥时摔下楼梯，迅速而无痛地结束了自己悲惨的一生。不过，因失去家庭经济支柱而领到的抚恤金，让你们有机会开始做些生意。

诺尔玛决定卖掉房子，投入几乎全部资金，在世界另一端买下一家汽车旅馆。而那正是你们如今要去的地方…

这座宅邸，也就是“惊魂之屋”，会替你守住那些隐秘的癖好。

[编译自[url=https://www.patreon.com/P_S_Y_C_H_O]Patreon[/url]]
